required_capabilities: Create Door/Window Type (×2); Load Library Element Type (×2); Create Door (×2); Inspect Project (×1)
instruction: The room is a simple rectangle with four exterior walls already built. Do not modify any walls. Place an M_Door-Double-Sliding door on the top (north) wall, 1800 × 2100 mm, with its left edge 3000 mm from the top-left corner, measured along the wall. Place an 'M_Door-Exterior-Double-Full Glass-Wood_Clad' double door on the right (east) wall, 1800 × 2100 mm, opening outward, with its edge closest to the top-right corner 2500 mm from that corner, measured down along the wall. Create no additional doors or openings.
